builds.difficulty: Provisional CR 2. ECL 2 (1 class HD, LA +1).
builds.speed: 20 ft. in armor (base land speed 30 ft.)
builds.title: Aasimar lantern escort, Paladin 1
traits: Lawful good. Material Plane. Scale mail +4, light wooden shield +1, Dexterity +1. Touch 11, flat-footed 15. BAB +1, grapple +4. Fortitude +4, Reflex +1, Will +2.
Acid resistance 5, cold resistance 5, and electricity resistance 5.
Aura of good. Detect evil at will as the spell. Weapon Focus (longsword) adds +1 to longsword attack rolls.
actions: Longsword +5 melee, 1d8+3 slashing, critical 19–20/×2. Smite Evil 1/day with a normal melee attack. With the longsword against an evil target, attack at +8 for 1d8+4. An attempt against a non-evil target has no smite effect and uses the daily use.

Daylight (Sp), 1/day at CL 1 from character level. Standard action, touch one object. Bright light in a 60-ft. radius and dim light for another 60 ft. Lasts 10 minutes and can be dismissed. It applies bright-light penalties. Creatures damaged or destroyed by actual sunlight take no such damage from daylight.
builds.tactics: Iona leads the last ferrymen out of a dark quay passage. She puts daylight on a lantern and gives it to a ferryman so she can defend the group. Save Smite Evil for a confirmed evil foe.

builds.difficulty: Provisional CR 2. ECL 2 (1 class HD, LA +1).
builds.speed: 20 ft. in armor (base land speed 30 ft.)
builds.title: Aasimar Ysgard stair keeper, Cleric 1
traits: Neutral good, cleric of Pelor. This encounter takes place on Ysgard. Chainmail +5 and light wooden shield +1. Touch 10, flat-footed 16. BAB +0, grapple +1. Fortitude +4, Reflex +0, Will +5. Improved Initiative adds +4 initiative.
Acid resistance 5, cold resistance 5, and electricity resistance 5.

Healing and Sun domains. Healing adds +1 caster level to spells of the Healing subschool, including spontaneous cures. Once per day use greater turning in place of a regular turning attempt. Undead that would be turned by that attempt are destroyed instead.
actions: Turn undead 5/day. Turning check 1d20+2 determines the highest individual HD affected. Turning damage is 2d6+3 total HD. One attempt may be greater turning.

Prepared cleric spells, CL 1 unless stated. Cantrips are detect magic, guidance, and light. First-level spells are bless and protection from evil. Domain slot is cure light wounds at CL 2 for 1d8+2 healing.

Daylight (Sp), 1/day at CL 1 from character level. Standard action, touch one object. Bright light in a 60-ft. radius and dim light for another 60 ft. Lasts 10 minutes and can be dismissed. It applies bright-light penalties. Creatures damaged or destroyed by actual sunlight take no such damage from daylight.
builds.tactics: Teren keeps watch at a stair in Ysgard where travelers lost their lanterns. He lights the handrail and helps them reach the upper landing. If undead block the stair, he uses turning and saves healing for the injured.

concepts.name: Iona Vale
concepts.motive: Bring the last ferrymen out of the quay passage.
concepts.hook: Iona needs help clearing the quay before the next ferry arrives.

concepts.name: Teren Mere
concepts.motive: Guide the stranded travelers to the upper landing.
concepts.hook: Teren has heard footsteps from below the dark stair.
